description: Pinned manifest for the Kun Chen OSS agent stack (treehouse / gnhf / no-mistakes / lavish-axi / firstmate). Drives bin/kun-stack-{install,verify,uninstall}. Idempotent via version-probe + marker files. Bump a version here, re-run kun-stack-install.

treehouse.role: Pooled pre-warmed git worktrees (substrate for parallel agents).

no-mistakes.role: The automated delivery gate (review/test/document/lint -> configured push target; PR when applicable).

gnhf.role: Long-run single-objective autonomous loop (depth). Replaced ralph.

lavish-axi.role: Plan-of-record / human review surface. Usually run via npx; global install optional.

firstmate.role: Crew orchestrator (breadth). An AGENTS.md directory, NOT a binary; launch your agent inside it.

notes.go_toolchain: go install requires a Go toolchain (>=1.21). kun-stack-install probes for `go`; if absent it logs and skips go tools (use the upstream install.sh as a fallback).
notes.axi: axi is the AXI interface standard (see the `axi` skill), surfaced by lavish-axi and no-mistakes axi; there is no separate `axi` binary to pin here.
notes.drive_bootstrap: false: kun-stack-install never auto-runs treehouse init / no-mistakes init / firstmate bootstrap. Those are per-repo, opt-in, and run explicitly.
